text: huh which is funny because that also means effectively as long as you know this data shape, like say, make it into a library for example, you can let someone create their own interface entirely for authoring what would load into the game, which is actually an interesting thought if anything.
resolution: Confirmed the implication from the ruled game-data architecture: once the data shape is stable and wrapped as a library, alternate authoring interfaces can generate valid game input for the same loader. Framed the boundary as semantic authoring API + validation/compiler, not raw lump hand-authoring; new behavior still requires engine capability rather than per-game script.
